Stephen Crane, The Red Badge of Courage.
Standard Ebooks edition: https://standardebooks.org/ebooks/stephen-crane/the-red-badge-of-courage

People whose words are in the text, and their death years:
- Stephen Crane, the author, died 1900.

First publication of the text used: 1895 (SE colophon: 'The Red Badge of Courage was published in 1895 by Stephen Crane.')

Why this is public domain:
- United States: the rights statement quoted below places the text in the United States public domain. The text was first published in 1895, before 1931.
- Country of origin: every person whose words are in the text died in 1925 or earlier, so the text is public domain in every country with a term of life + 100 years or less, whatever its country of first publication.
